label: Bible Study
prompt: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the _____ is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
verse: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
note: The swift don't always win, nor the strong — time and chance happen to everyone.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the _____ returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
verse: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
note: The shepherds went back to their flocks still praising — that night shift had never been this good.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt _____ the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verse: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
note: At Horeb, God said strike the rock; years later at Meribah he said speak to it — and the difference mattered.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are _____ already to harvest.
verse: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
note: Samaritan townspeople were already heading toward Jesus as he spoke — the 'harvest' was walking up the road.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he was afraid, and said, How _____ is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
verse: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
note: Jacob woke from the ladder dream: 'How dreadful is this place!' — dread as holy awe at the very gate of heaven.
